goal: Beat VTI after realistic costs. That is the pass Dan named for this test.
hypothesis: Among names that pass the same eligibility gate and have both endpoint closes, ranking by the split-and-dividend-adjusted return from the session 12 calendar months earlier through the session 7 calendar months earlier beats a VTI hold on both disjoint 365-day windows at 5 and 10 bps per side, and beats fixed ma50-extension rank on that same set without a drawdown more than 2.0 percentage points worse.
one_knob: Sort key only. The learner score is close(S7)/close(S12)-1. The extension book uses feature 0. Stops, hold, sizing, sleeve, name cap, fills, and the 7-minute quote cap stay as in local_expectancy_v1.

score.S7: Last shared session on or before the decision date minus 7 calendar months. Day-of-month clamps to the target month.
score.S12: Last shared session on or before the decision date minus 12 calendar months.
score.decision: The session close that forms eligibility. The fill is the next session open. Neither endpoint is the decision close.
score.missing: If either endpoint bar is absent, or S7 is not strictly after S12, the name is out of both books that day.
score.price: The same Yahoo adjusted open/close panel as local_expectancy_v1. One series. No unadjusted mix and no new download.

eligibility: extension > 0 and rsi14 < 0.70 and both endpoints present. One top name per session.
baseline: fixed_ma50_extension on that same eligible set
primary_benchmark: VTI buy and hold, same window, same per-side slippage, enter first open, liquidate last close
also_reported: equal-weight hold of the included names
universe: symbols_included from the local_expectancy results. SPCX stays out.
